entries.author: Vitaly V. Kuzmin
entries.note: 2S19M2 left front quarter: T-80/T-72 derived hull, six road wheels, the large turret with the 2A64 152 mm gun, its fume extractor and muzzle brake, the commander's cupola with the remote MG.

entries.author: Vitaly V. Kuzmin
entries.note: Rear quarter: the turret's rear ammunition door and crane, side stowage.

entries.author: Vitaly V. Kuzmin
entries.note: Rear: the turret rear, the conveyor hatch, the hull rear with its self-entrenching blade.

entries.author: Алексей Китаев
entries.note: RAE 2013 car in desert finish, front quarter with the gun raised.

entries.author: Владислав Фальшивомонетчик
entries.note: 2S19 (earlier standard; hull and turret shell as the M2) square-on left side at a parade rehearsal, nose left, gun slightly elevated. Scaled to the 7.15 m hull: deck 1.29 m, turret roof 2.82 m, cupola 2.97 m (the published 2.985 m height), turret 3.99 m long from 1.53 m ahead of hull centre to 2.46 m behind, trunnion near 1.35 m ahead at 2.19 m, about 5.5 m of barrel ahead of it.

entries.author: 25th Sicheslavshchyna Air Assault Brigade
entries.note: Captured 2S19M2, near side-on from the front left with a soldier beside it for scale (wide angle, close). Road wheels give about 147 px/m at the turret front: deck edge about 1.36 m, turret roof about 2.9 m.
